build: lean-muscled, the kind of strength that comes from making things by hand
hair: black, thick and straight, usually in a long braid down her back or twisted into a knot; she pulls it loose when she's thinking hard
complexion: warm bronze undertone with a faint scar along her left collarbone — old, from a childhood fall on ice
face: a face that broadcasts everything: wide-set dark eyes that go soft or sharp depending on her mood, high cheekbones, a mouth quick to smile or tremble, the kind of openness that makes people either trust her immediately or sense they can wound her
signature_feature: her hands — long-fingered, capable, always slightly marked with indigo dye or pencil smudges; the LI notices how she moves them when she talks, how deliberately she touches things she cares about
second_celebrated_feature: the precise, almost musical quality of her voice — low and clear, with a slight rasp when she's tired or emotional
signature_habits: she hums while working, usually old songs her grandmother taught her in Inuktitut; she keeps a worn leather notebook for sketches and observations; she touches her collarbone scar absently when she's anxious or remembering something; she makes tea in the evenings, the ritual of heating water and waiting seeming to calm her; she speaks her thoughts aloud to herself, unfiltered
occupation: textile and fiber artist — she owns a small independent studio where she hand-dyes fabrics, creates custom weaving commissions, and teaches workshops; the studio is her sanctuary and her livelihood, housed in a converted warehouse space she can barely afford

current_crisis.event: her landlord — a property developer backed by venture capital — has given her 60 days' notice; the building is being sold and demolished for luxury condos; she has no savings buffer, no backup location, and three major client commissions due in eight weeks
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic mixed with a crushing sense of erasure — this space, this work, feels like the only solid thing she owns
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find a way to keep her studio alive, or at minimum to finish her commissions before everything collapses

wound.core: she believes that anything she builds will eventually be taken from her, that her work and her presence don't matter enough to be protected
wound.surfacing_hint: when stressed, she becomes almost apologetic about existing — she takes up less space, speaks quieter, assumes she's in the way; she also catastrophizes silently, her mind jumping to worst-case scenarios she doesn't voice until forced
